component.name: ZhiStar Nova
component.summary: A modern web browser powered by WebKitGTK

description.p: ZhiStar Nova is a fast, lightweight web browser built on WebKitGTK with a Firefox-inspired UI. It features a starry sky homepage, rich settings, ad blocking, tab pinning, download management, and full Chinese/English internationalization.
Initial release of ZhiStar Nova browser.
